zh-CN.title: 移动端聊天输入框修复
items: 修复部分安卓设备和手机模拟模式下输入框工具按钮被裁切的问题
修复 iOS 键盘弹出后聊天页可滚动、出现纯色空屏及键盘上方留白的问题

en.title: Mobile chat composer fixes
items: Fixed composer tool buttons being clipped on some Android devices and mobile emulation
Fixed iOS page scrolling, blank screens, and gaps above the keyboard while typing
